acceptance: Native WNF test independently checks fixed process-name registry provisioning before asserting presence; an absent provisioned name must remain absent, never fabricated.
If provisioned, preserve exact private-process initialization stamp0/empty payload and the typed-system native oracle.
Bracket registry and typed-state observations; explicit failure on unsupported native status or exhausted changes, no platform skip or host mutation.
Keep portable private payload-isolation coverage, validate Windows/macOS/Linux and publish exact red changesets and paired root pin.
